**verdict**: CANARY PASS (dig-in overturns the initial FAIL read: the mechanism is healthy and the canary bar's 'reward improving by 2M' clause was miscalibrated, demonstrated by matched-step control). Plain English: the transformer was about to be declared broken because its reward fell for all 2M steps while 'the MLP sibling learns healthy (rising to 746)' - but that compared the transformer at 2M steps against the MLP at 38M. The 'identical collapse signature' across 1L/d64 and 2L/d128 is the architecture-INDEPENDENT early reward valley of the V7 stack at 100Hz, not an attention defect. INTERPRETATION: at 2M the reward curve is set by the env/reward schedule + shared seed, not the trunk - which is why 4x width/depth reproduced it point-for-point; the pre-registered 'improving by 2M' clause would have FAILED the only architecture that ever passed the full gate.
